summary: Muncy Columbia Financial Corp (CCFN) filed an 8-K announcing a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.155 per share and a new treasury stock repurchase program authorizing repurchase of up to 530,611 shares (5% of outstanding). The dividend is payable June 11, 2026 to holders of record May 26, 2026. The buyback is effective May 15, 2026 through May 15, 2028, conducted in open market or private transactions, with all repurchased shares held as treasury. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor was named. This is a standard capital return event; watch for ongoing execution pace and any acceleration of buybacks.
